description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to amend the Service Minute on Secretaries, w.e.f. 04.07.2019
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the "Service Minute on Secretaries," which deals specifically with public service conditions, specifically pension revisions for re-employed Secretaries upon cessation of service. This falls under public sector administration, service conditions, and retirement benefits, making it a clear example of a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
